jobs.title: Senior FP&A Analyst
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Monarch is a powerful, all-in-one personal finance platform designed to help make the complexity of finances feel simple again. Since launching in 2021, we've become the top-recommended personal finance app by users and experts. Our goal? To take the stress out of finances so our members can focus on what truly matters.

We are a team of do-ers led by experienced entrepreneurs who are passionate about helping our members reach their financial goals. We're hyper focused on building a product people love, and on finding every edge that helps us do that better. AI is core to how we operate: every person on the team uses it as a partner to sharpen judgment, move faster, and expand what's possible. We're not looking for tool mastery, we're looking for fluency and curiosity. What matters is that AI is part of how you work today and that you're actively raising your own bar on how to use it well.

As a fully remote company (even before COVID!), we welcome applicants from almost anywhere. Our team collaborates synchronously mostly from 9 AM – 2 PM PT and embraces asynchronous work to stay connected across time zones.

Join us on our mission to transform lives by simplifying money, together.




THE ROLE:

Monarch Money is seeking a Senior FP&A Analyst to support scaling our finance function. Reporting to the Head of FP&A, you'll be central to the planning cadence the whole company runs on — supporting the annual budget and quarterly re-forecast, maintaining our core operating model, and partnering with Accounting on monthly reporting and variance analysis.

This role blends analytical depth with real business partnership. You'll own departmental financial alignment across Growth, Product, Engineering, People, and CS, making sure every team is operating against a plan they understand and are accountable to. The ideal candidate is a hands-on builder — comfortable when the process doesn't exist yet, and able to turn complex financial data into something a non-finance leader can act on.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Planning & Forecasting:
   
   - Support the annual budget and quarterly re-forecast — running the calendar, templates, and working sessions with department leaders and Strategic Operations, and consolidating the result
   
   - Maintain and extend our three statement financial model
   
   - Support long-range planning and scenario modeling for growth, hiring, and capital decisions

 - Business Partnership:
   
   - Own departmental financial alignment — run a recurring review cadence with each department leader on budget, spend, and headcount against plan
   
   - Serve as the finance approver in Zip for vendor and purchase requests — validating spend against budget before it's committed, and pushing back when it isn't covered
   
   - Monitor spend in Ramp against plan, and maintain the renewal calendar so contract decisions happen ahead of auto-renewal rather than after
   
   - Give department leaders visibility into their own committed and remaining budget
   
   - Flag variances and emerging risks in-period, proactively, rather than explaining them after the fact
   
   - Help non-finance leaders read their own numbers and connect spend to outcomes

 - Reporting & Analysis:
   
   - Partner with Accounting through month-end close — accruals, plan-to-actual reconciliation, and a monthly reporting package delivered on a predictable cadence
   
   - Produce variance analysis with written commentary explaining the why, not just the delta
   
   - Prepare metrics, schedules, and narrative inputs for investor updates and board reporting
   
   - Take on ad-hoc analysis and build the decks that frame decisions for leadership

 - Systems & Automation:
   
   - Improve and automate recurring reporting in Aleph and Omni — less manual effort each cycle, more self-serve for the teams who need answers
     
     


WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - 4+ years in FP&A or corporate finance, with direct exposure to a full planning cycle

 - You build things other people can operate. Advanced Excel/Google Sheets modeling.

 - You've had the harder conversation. You've sat with a non-finance leader whose spend diverged from plan and worked it through, rather than escalating it

 - You make complex things simple. Financial concepts land with people who don't have a finance background

 - You'd rather flag a surprise early than present a polished answer late

 - You're comfortable when the process doesn't exist yet and would rather build it than wait for it
   
   


NICE TO HAVE'S:

 - Experience in a subscription, SaaS, or fintech business

 - SQL and familiarity with BI tooling (Omni, Looker, or equivalent)

 - Experience with a modern ERP (Rillet, NetSuite) or planning tool (Aleph, Pigment, Anaplan, Adaptive)

 - Experience with procurement or spend management tooling (Zip, Coupa, Airbase, Navan)

 - Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field
   
   


TYPICAL PROCESS (MAY VARY DEPENDING ON ROLE):

 - Recruiter Video Call

 - Hiring Manager Video Call

 - Take Home Case Study + Walkthrough

 - Virtual Onsite Round

 - Reference Checks

 - Offer!

#LI-DNI


BENEFITS :

 - Work wherever you want! As a fully remote company with no central office, we want you to work wherever you are happiest and most productive. Whether that’s out of your home, a co-working space, or elsewhere.

 - Competitive cash and equity compensation in a hyper growth, early stage company 🚀.

 - Stipend to set-up your ideal working environment.

 - Competitive Benefit Plans for employees based on your location (e.g. in the US we offer: Medical, dental and vision benefits and the ability to contribute to a 401k plan).

 - Unlimited PTO.

 - 3 day weekend every month! We take off the “First Friday” every month to focus on rest, recuperation, or just having fun!




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & NON-DISCRIMINATION

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or genetic information.




APPLICANT NOTICES

California & San Francisco: Pursuant to the California Fair Chance Act and the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment. We comply with all applicable fair chance hiring laws.

jobs.description:

Monarch is a powerful, all-in-one personal finance platform designed to help make the complexity of finances feel simple again. Since launching in 2021, we've become the top-recommended personal finance app by users and experts. Our goal? To take the stress out of finances so our members can focus on what truly matters.

We are a team of do-ers led by experienced entrepreneurs who are passionate about helping our members reach their financial goals. We're hyper focused on building a product people love, and on finding every edge that helps us do that better. AI is core to how we operate: every person on the team uses it as a partner to sharpen judgment, move faster, and expand what's possible. We're not looking for tool mastery, we're looking for fluency and curiosity. What matters is that AI is part of how you work today and that you're actively raising your own bar on how to use it well.

As a fully remote company (even before COVID!), we welcome applicants from almost anywhere. Our team collaborates synchronously mostly from 9 AM – 2 PM PT and embraces asynchronous work to stay connected across time zones.

Join us on our mission to transform lives by simplifying money, together.




THE ROLE:

Monarch is seeking a Principal, Procurement to join our Finance team during a period of rapid growth. Reporting to the Head of Operations and Finance, you will own and mature our existing procurement program, lead strategic sourcing and negotiations, and build a proactive approach to vendor and technology-spend management.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with significant company-wide impact. You will partner closely with Finance, Engineering, Legal, Security, IT, People, and business leaders to help Monarch make better purchasing decisions, improve vendor economics, and ensure our technology spend scales efficiently.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Own and continuously improve Monarch’s company-wide procurement process, including system administration for Zip, ensuring it remains efficient, scalable, and easy for teams to navigate.

 - Lead strategic sourcing and negotiations for material vendors, using market intelligence, usage data, and business context to improve pricing, terms, commitments, and overall value.

 - Build a proactive vendor-management program that provides clear visibility into contracts, spend, ownership, renewals, utilization, performance, and consolidation opportunities.

 - Partner with Finance, Engineering, and business leaders to improve the commercial economics of Monarch’s SaaS, cloud, data, AI, and other technology spend.

 - Drive adoption through clear policies, self-service resources, and employee education developed with People, while using AI and automation to make procurement faster and more proactive.
   
   


WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

 - 7+ years of relevant experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, vendor management, or technology-spend management, including personal ownership of material negotiations.

 - Demonstrated experience owning and meaningfully improving procurement processes in a high-growth technology company, ideally within B2C, subscription, SaaS, or fintech.

 - Hands-on experience administering a procurement-orchestration or comparable workflow platform, including configuring intake, conditional logic, approval routing, permissions, and reporting.

 - Experience sourcing and negotiating technology spend, including SaaS, cloud infrastructure, data, AI, or other consumption-based vendor models.

 - Experience partnering with Finance and Engineering to manage cloud or other usage-based technology spend and translate cost and usage insights into commercial decisions.

 - Strong commercial and analytical judgment, including the ability to connect spend and utilization data to business value and unit economics.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence leaders, challenge requests constructively, create clear employee guidance, and drive cross-functional decisions without formal authority.

 - A proactive, hands-on operating style and the ability to manage multiple priorities, move between strategy and execution, and bring clear recommendations to ambiguous decisions.

 - Demonstrated AI fluency: You use AI regularly in your work, have a clear point of view on where it helps and where it doesn’t, and continuously raise your own bar. You are excited to redesign procurement workflows around AI and automation—not just use AI to complete existing tasks faster.
   
   


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Direct experience administering Zip or a comparable procurement-orchestration platform.

 - Familiarity with AWS and Google Cloud cost structures, committed-use agreements, cloud cost allocation, or cloud-cost-management tooling.

 - Experience procuring AI models, APIs, financial-data infrastructure, or other high-volume usage-based services.

 - Experience in fintech, consumer subscription, financial services, or another regulated technology environment.

 - Familiarity with security, privacy, legal, and third-party risk-review processes.
   
   


TYPICAL PROCESS:

 - Recruiter video call

 - Hiring manager video call

 - Take-home assignment

 - Virtual onsite consisting of 2–4 interviews

 - Reference checks

 - Offer


BENEFITS :

 - Work wherever you want! As a fully remote company with no central office, we want you to work wherever you are happiest and most productive. Whether that’s out of your home, a co-working space, or elsewhere.

 - Competitive cash and equity compensation in a hyper growth, early stage company 🚀.

 - Stipend to set-up your ideal working environment.

 - Competitive Benefit Plans for employees based on your location (e.g. in the US we offer: Medical, dental and vision benefits and the ability to contribute to a 401k plan).

 - Unlimited PTO.

 - 3 day weekend every month! We take off the “First Friday” every month to focus on rest, recuperation, or just having fun!




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & NON-DISCRIMINATION

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or genetic information.

THE ROLE

As a Customer Success Lead, you'll be the escalation point and source of expertise for the agents handling our customer tickets. You'll proactively step in on our most complex and sensitive customer conversations, and drive improvements through training, documentation, and process work across CS. The ideal candidate brings strong communication skills, a customer-first mindset, and an eye for the patterns behind individual tickets.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Escalations and customer advocacy

 - Triage agent escalations, resolving or routing as appropriate and coaching agents in the process

 - Communicate directly with customers on complex or sensitive cases requiring specialized support

 - Own customer issues that reach us publicly rather than through a support ticket, including app store reviews, community forums, and social channels

Agent enablement and process improvement

 - Audit ticket queues to flag QA issues, process inefficiencies, and tickets requiring escalation

 - Surface emergent trends that require a broader solution, with the context needed to act on them

 - Engage in training for new agent cohorts and ongoing enablement for the existing team

 - Create and maintain internal documentation, process guides, and training materials that help agents resolve more on their own

 - Own accuracy and clarity of customer-facing Help Center content

 - Take on scoped pieces of CS department projects, from process changes to improvements in the team's internal tooling
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 3+ years in customer-facing support roles, at least 2 of which included email/async support for an online consumer product (B2C SaaS)

 - Clear written communication, with the ability to effectively write help articles, training materials, or de-escalation emails

 - Excellent customer instincts and strong de-escalation skills, including those surfaced from public view (app store reviews and community forums)

 - Self-direction in a remote, async environment; takes action where needed and flags early when stuck

 - Ownership beyond ticket scope, with the ability to identify emergent support trends and propose improvements to QA, training, or content
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Personal finance (PFM) knowledge

 - Experience supporting a subscription-based consumer app, including billing, account, renewal, and cancellation questions

 - Experience with AI-assisted support tooling and workflow automation

 - Experience contributing to a formal agent training, onboarding, or QA program
